purpose: Discord presentation and interaction validation for a committed TagDuel LP-gain/Fire Princess pipeline result.

groups: public shared LP projection and private hand isolation
real handleTagComponent End Phase interaction and revision persistence
stale Discord interaction rejection without LP overwrite
Discord payload validation for public and private panels

contract: The M452 plan is applied only by the trusted test caller to the two shared team LP totals.
The public Discord embed displays the exact committed team LP totals.
Public payloads contain no physical UIDs or private hand identities.
Private panels expose the active representative's action menu only.
A real handleTagComponent action is acknowledged before mutation and refreshes the public panel.
A stale revision cannot overwrite the newer persisted session.
limitations: Uses an isolated SQLite database and the real Discord interaction handler/payload builders without a live Discord gateway.
The fixture has no Fire Princess copy, so it validates LP display after a positive source gain without testing a live trigger.
No production session or player inventory is modified.
